maker: Shenzhen Legend Robot Technology Co., Ltd.
variant: Putty & Latex Paint Spraying Robot, 6.2 m
name: Legend Robot LQ06A putty and latex paint spraying robot (6.2 m)
summary: Wheeled interior finishing robot with telescopic outriggers, a lifting mast and a six-axis arm that sprays putty and latex paint airless onto walls and ceilings up to 6.2 m in halls, schools, hospitals and factories. High-wall version of the LQ00C.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU seller found; enquiries go to the maker in Shenzhen (quote form, e-mail, WhatsApp). Legend Robot says it previewed its latex paint and putty spraying robot at BATIMAT 2026 in Paris with its "European partner ROBOSWISS AG" and that the system is engineered to EU CE standards, but the article does not name the model or spraying height and no European sales page or price was found.

specs.label: Putty output per day
specs.quote: Daily productivity reaches 1,000–1,200 m² for the first coat and 1,600–2,000 m² for the second coat

specs.label: Putty coat thickness
specs.quote: The first coat of putty is applied at 1.2–1.5 mm thickness, and the second coat at 0.6–0.9 mm

specs.label: Dimensions
specs.conditions: the page prints the three figures run together

specs.label: Crew
specs.value: 1 robot + 2 operators for putty; 1 operator for 3 robots for latex paint
specs.conditions: one operator runs the robot, one scrapes the putty

notes: Omnidirectional chassis, telescopic outriggers that form a four-point base for high spraying, lifting mechanism and 6-DOF arm (maker). Wheels assumed.
One robot for putty and latex paint by switching material; comes with a putty mixer and three-stage filtration.
Maker calls the body under 800 mm per side, while the spec table gives 1500 × 780 mm; the larger figure may include the outriggers.
runtimeH is the stated 8 h with both batteries.
